title: Northgate Optical Material Refund Share Schedule
content:
**Material refund share, Northgate Optical in-lab cancellations.** The material refund share is 100 percent when the job is cancelled no more than 3 calendar days after its order date and 80 percent when it is cancelled 4 to 14 calendar days after it. A cancellation later than 14 calendar days after the order date is outside this schedule.

| Calendar days after the order date | Material refund share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | 100 percent |
| 4 to 14 | 80 percent |

The days are counted from the eyewear job's order date to the day of the cancellation, when the refund is worked out; a cancellation on the order date is 0 days after it.

### Edges (hypothetical job ordered on 20 October 2025)

| Cancelled on | Days | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 23 October 2025 | 3 | 100 percent |
| 24 October 2025 | 4 | 80 percent |
| 3 November 2025 | 14 | 80 percent |
| 4 November 2025 | 15 | outside this schedule |

On a refundable material amount of 15.00 (hypothetical), the two shares give 15.00 and 12.00.
